text: Shefferd was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Shel'drozul is a fel lord located at the Legion Invasion locations. He later appeared in Stormheim.
Shawn McClinter is a human located at Westwind Weald in Tiragarde Sound.
Shepherd Mary Ann Milbrooke is a human located at Millstone Hamlet in Stormsong Valley. She wants to have the local wolf population quelled and asks to find one of her sheep flock, Millie.
Sheha Ironbone is an orc located at Hillcrest Pasture in Stormsong Valley.
Shelley Lowe is a human located in Blushwater Brook in Tiragarde Sound.

Shenda was one of the fifteen night elf druids who accompanied Ferryn in moving through the treetops of Ashenvale and ambushing Horde forces during the War of the Thorns. While in :Cat Form, she was sleek and blue-gray with foot-long fangs. When the druid group was attacked by the blood elf Lorash Sunbeam, Shenda pounced at the attacker, but Ferryn watched in horror as her throat suddenly opened, after which her body tumbled toward the ground below.

Shendruk is an orc stationed in Darkshore. She reports directly to Nathanos Blightcaller and witnessed the return of the night elves for the Battle for Darkshore. During Aftermath (quest), she appears at Lor'danel Landing.
Sherra Vayne was a human located at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
Shear Fury is a Vengeance demon hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Fracture.
Sheridon Hastle is a Wildhammer dwarf located in Zaralek Cavern.
Shikrik is an orc shaman trainer located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar.
Shindigger's Camp is a small camp in the Hinterlands where the drunken dwarf Rhapsody Shindigger and the high elf Gilveradin Sunchaser are located.
Shill Dinger is a human prisoner found inside the Halls of the Law of Blackrock Depths.
Shieldbearer Anak is a human located in Tirisfal Glades. She assists the adventurer during The Silver Hand (quest) alongside Helda the Breaker, Lyanae, and Kelissa Stilwell.
Shimidormi is a bronze dragon located in the Late Night Lab in Thaldraszus. She is found chatting with Falastrasz and Osithra.
Shikari Eilakar is a blood elf found near the entrance to the Halls of Atonement in Revendreth. She is accompanied by her pet, Malice.
Shinmura is a blood elf located in a cave in Igira's Watch in Zaralek Cavern.

Shiromar is a night elf priestess and a veteran of the War of the Shifting Sands. She carried the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and rang the Scarab Gong to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj and begin the second War of the Shifting Sands, making her the Scarab Lord.
Shoma is an orc weapon vendor located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.
Shomei is a gnome warrior who fought against many slave goblins in order to reach their leader, the goblin tinker Kritok — who he eventually killed.

Shorty is a dwarf found in Dun Morogh. He is a part of a dwarven mortar team consisting of himself and Angus. Sometimes he and Angus will fire their mortar on some training dummies. Sometimes they jokingly hit Spotter Klemmy.
Shocuul is an Alliance draenei warrior found at the Argent Tournament in Icecrown. He also has a chance to appear in the Trial of the Crusader against the Horde.

Sho is a pandaren rogue and member of the Tillers. Unlike the other Tillers, who are mainly farmers, Sho works to protect the Valley of the Four Winds from various foes, subsequently ensuring the safety of the Tillers and their harvests.
Shokia is an orc marksman and part of the veteran team that entered Pandaria on the gunship Hellscream's Fist. She is a herbalism trainer while in the Jade Forest.
Shive was an orc working with Havoc the Heartless and killed by Nori Blackfinger.
Shok Narnes is an orc located at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Shoka is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Shoyu is a pandaren monk trainer found at Camp Narache in Mulgore.
Shrinekeeper Qanosh is a djaradin priest located in Zaqali Caldera in Zaralek Cavern. He is guarding the area with Earthrender Ku'siva, but is attacked by Sabellian, Ebyssian, and an adventurer.
Sian'dur was a jungle troll hunter trainer located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.

Sida was a dwarf located in Menethil Harbor in the Alliance-aligned zone of the Wetlands. She tasked adventurers with recovering her bag she had lost while on a visit to Ironbeard's Tomb. She was apparently on bad terms with her husband Einar Stonegrip, as he refused to travel to Menethil while she was still there. Following the Cataclysm, she is missing; likely killed by the tsunami that hit Menethil Harbor.
Shyrka Wolfrunner is an orc stable master located in Camp Mojache in Feralas.
Sid Limbardi is a human innkeeper located at Honor Hold in the Hellfire Peninsula.
Shrye Ragefist is an orc found in Alterac Valley. She appears during the Heritage of Draenor questline at Frostwolf Village.
Siegesmith Gulda is an orc blacksmithing supplies vendor located at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight.

Shu is the forever-young ancient spirit of water on the Wandering Isle. He can be found sulking in the Pool of Reflection because his best friend Liang is now too old to play with him. The elemental is fond of playing with people by launching them into the air with water. At least once he played with Li Li Stormstout. She had to run after him, but she lost his trail in Wu-Song Village.

Siat Honeydew is a level 85 pandaren monk located in Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest. He can be found in an isolated building outside the village walls, that can be reached passing the bridge and a high stair starting behind the on-fire fields outside the town. He's a monk and can be seen training.
Shu Blindeye was a pandaren emperor of the Pandaren Empire. The Pearl of Yu'lon was carved during his reign in honor of the Jade Serpent.

Siegemaster Mar'tak is an orc located at the Iron Bulwark in . She takes part in the Hellfire Assault encounter but flees upon reaching 50% health. She returns in the next encounter directly afterwards as the one piloting the Iron Reaver.
Sigil Mastery is a demon hunter PvP talent, available at level 20.
Siegemaster Voraan is a fel lord in Darkfall Ridge. He is the leader of the demon army in the area.
Silent Resolve is a priest talent that lowers threat generation, as well as gives better resistance to dispel mechanics.
Silanna is a blood elf located in a small building northwest of the North Sanctum in Eversong Woods.
Sigrid Iceborn's Proto-Drake is the dragon she rides in on at the ring of Valhalas in Icecrown. It's possibly also the proto-drake she used for her Hyldsmeet.
Silence is a Shadow priest talent. It silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 seconds, and acts against an interrupt against non-player targets.
Silent Boris is a human located in a cave at Algerson Lumber Yard in Tiragarde Sound.
Silbermana Dawncap is a night elf vendor located in a house within the Whispering Bluffs in Val'sharah.

Silverbrook is a seemingly ordinary town of human trappers in the northern Grizzly Hills. It is nestled among the Silverbrook Hills, close to Drak'tharon Keep and just west of the Blue Sky Logging Grounds. The town is encircled by a wooden palisade and contains four large towers and a number of loghouses. It is under constant attack by the Horde soldiers from Conquest Hold.
Simon Tanner is a human artisan leatherworking trainer located in Old Town in Stormwind.
Sinda is a night elf leather armor vendor located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Master Simeon is a human mage and instructor for young mages. He, alongside his student; Aodhan, and Archmage Rhonin, managed to stop the rogue mage, Crevan, from making Dalaran drop from the sky. As explained by Rhonin, Simeon isn't a member of the Kirin Tor because he long ago rejected it so as to have more time to train those who are their future.
Sin'dorei Spirit is a ghost of a blood elf at Lake Kel'theril in central Winterspring. He is one of three spirits that are visited to figure out the curse of Zin-Malor. The other two are a and a .
Sindragosa's Fury was a Frost death knight major artifact trait for the Blades of the Fallen Prince. It was linked to the Dead of Winter (artifact trait) trait.
Sinew was a yeti of the Feral Scar and a brother of the tribe's leader with the same name. He was killed by the Gordunni ogres who invaded the haven, their home.

Singer is a rare mob human found roaming the farm at Northfold Manor in the Arathi Highlands. Her mask smells faintly of peppermint kisses and murder, two of her favorite things. In Classic, she is on a 5 to 8 hour respawn timer. If you are under her Dominate Mind spell while she dies from DOT or your pet you will not be able to loot her corpse. In Battle for Azeroth, she appears at Dabyrie's Farmstead or Go'Shek Farm.
Single-Minded Fury is a Fury warrior talent. It is an alternative to Titan's Grip, allowing a Warrior to remain competitive while Dual Wielding one-handed weapons.
Sir Jonathan Trueheart is a human located at the Legerdemain Lounge in Dalaran.

Sir Alamande Graythorn is a human of the Order of the Silver Hand located in the Sanctum of Light. Alamande comes from Hearthglen and is a noted scholar. He researches the class hall upgrades and becomes available after completing the mission Wrath and Justice which awards Sir Alamande Graythorn (item). He has long retired from battle.
Sinister Thoughts is a Shadow priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Thoughts of Insanity trait.
Sinister Specter was a Pale orc located in Haunted Precipice in Talador. He was taken out by the followers sent from the Frostwall and Lunarfall garrisons.

Sironas is a man'ari eredar who was employed by Kael'thas Sunstrider. She infiltrated the Exodar during the confusion of the battle between the blood elves and the draenei, before the vessel could transport itself away from Outland. Crashlanding on the Azuremyst Isles, Sironas rounded up some of the blood elves who had survived the wreck and retreated to what became Bloodmyst Isle. From there, the Sunhawks began causing major problems for the budding outpost of Blood Watch, laying claim to wreckage from the Exodar for their own purposes. Sironas began using the remains of the ship's Vector Coil to create Sun Gates, dimensional rifts allowing for a steady supply of reinforcements to be shippe

Sister Benedron is a human priestess featured in DC Unlimited's World of Warcraft: Series 3 action figure set. She appears to be wearing a stylized version of the Avatar Raiment set. Sister Benedron has not yet appeared in any other media.
Skeld Drakeson is the vrykul leader in Ember Clutch in Howling Fjord.
Sister Darnhald is a human paladin trainer located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

Sissy Flamecuffs is a gnome mage part of the Hodir encounter in Ulduar. She, along with her excavation team are trapped inside icicle blocks and must be freed if the raid wants help against Hodir. In 25man version she is replaced by Missy Flamecuffs.

Sister Elda is a dwarf located at the Sanctum of Light. She is the Head Archivist of the Knights of the Silver Hand and the author of the Libram of Ancient Kings. She begins the chain of steps required to obtain Heart of Corruption, by combining A Thoroughly Read Copy of "Nat Pagle's Guide to Extreme Anglin'." and Nat Pagle's Guide to Extreme Anglin' to create A Complete Copy of "Nat Pagle's Guide to Extreme Anglin'." You must have at least Artifact Knowledge Rank 6 before she offers the option.
Sister Yeselle is a night elf located in the Temple of Elune of Val'sharah.
Sister Oriel is a human priest located in Netherlight Temple.
Sister Westwood is a witch located at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar.
Sister Early is a human located at the Fletcher's Hollow in Drustvar.
Sister Ashwell is a human located at the Fletcher's Hollow in Drustvar.
Sister Mooring is a human located at the Fletcher's Hollow in Drustvar.
Sister Widdowson is a witch located at Hangman's Point in Drustvar.
Sister Littlefield is a witch located in a cellar at Arom's Stand in Drustvar. She has disguised herself as a Suspicious Refugee.
Sister Adela is a witch located at Watchman's Rise in Drustvar.
Sister Lilyana is a human located in Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.
Sister Lilias is a witch located north of Corlain in Drustvar. She is guarded by two Thorned Snarler.
Sister Hilga is a witch located in Arom's Crossing in Drustvar.
Sister Shandra is a human located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Sister Alison is a human innkeeper located in Tidecross in Stormsong Valley.
Sister Ava is a human located in Stormsong Valley. She killed Brother Addington.
Sister Price is a human located on an unnamed ship in Tiragarde Sound.

Skul is an elite rare mob skeletal mage found in Stratholme. Skul has an extremely infrequent spawn rate. He can spawn in the area near the Stratholme Courier and Fras Siabi or sometimes in the Festival Lane area.
Skolmin Goldfury is a dwarf bow vendor located in the northeast corner of the Military Ward within Ironforge. He works in Goldfury's Hunting Supplies.

Skibi was a human defender of an Alliance castle in the official Blizzard scenario map for Warcraft III called Skibi's Castle TD. Even though she lived in a castle, she was probably not royalty because she is not mentioned in any other lore, the actual reason to this is that the map was not originally created by Blizzard, but Blizzard liked it so much they made it a standard map. Adventurers built defenses around her castle to defend it from the evil demonic invasion coming from Dark Portals which had opened around Skibi's castle. The Dark Portals were opened by an evil entity named Rydik. Gameplay Skibi's Castle TD is a teamplay-map. It is split in two halves. On the left half of the map is

Skippy Hophappy is a goblin hunter that appears at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens. She left her pet boar, Mr. Oinky, with the stable master Vernon Soursprye, who cooked the pig over the nearby fire and told Skippy that Mr. Oinky ran away. Skippy, not recognizing her beloved pet roasting over the fire, ran off in search of Mr. Oinky.

Skezzo was a goblin who lived in Bilgewater Port and was the leader of the Copper Street Gang. He would constantly ask Luzik Gallywix to pay his debt and threaten to send Lumpo to blow up his shop. When he had enough, he went to Luzik and told him that he had until that night to pay him. Later on, Jastor Gallywix would appear for the payment. But instead gave him a bag full of dynamite. He and his gang were blown up.
Skoller is a human located at the Saberstalkers' camp north of Fang'rila in Tanaan Jungle. He is sitting on a wagon, surrounded by squirrels, whom he occasionally throw nuts to.
Skinny Tim is a human located at Castaway Point in Tiragarde Sound.
Skinner MacGuff is a human located in Deathmist Hills in Tiragarde Sound.

Skychaser was the wolf companion of Ner'zhul when he was leader of all shaman on Draenor. One memorable journey had Ner'zhul riding Skychaser to Oshu'gun in order to consult the ancestors about his orc companion's newest benefactor, Kil'jaeden. His status afterwards is unknown but it can be presumed that he was killed at some point.

Sky-Captain Mark Jackson is a human Sky-Captain of the Valiance Expedition aboard The Skybreaker in Icecrown. He is the only NPC on the Skybreaker that cannot be attacked, as such he cannot be killed, however he will not attack Horde players.

Sky Captain Swayze was the captain of the Skyfire, the Alliance gunship chasing after Deathwing in the Dragon Soul raid. After the defeat of Ultraxion, you will be able to board the ship and you can talk to him to start the Warmaster Blackhorn encounter. After the defeat of Blackhorn, the captain and Ka'anu Reevs are the first to jump off the ship and land on Deathwing's back, only to be tossed off a few moments later.
Sky Admiral Catherine Rogers is a high ranking human officer of the Alliance. She commanded the Alliance gunship Skyfire after the apparent demise of Sky Captain Swayze. She also owns a gyrocopter.
Sky Captain Callanan is the human sky captain on the Alliance gunship and navy flagship the Skyfire, second to Sky Admiral Rogers.
Sky-Reaver Stormhowl was a planned Mag'har orc who would take part in Theramore's Fall. He was to be the captain of Fist of Garrosh instructing the rescue team on Theramore.
Skybreaker Transport Pilot is a human located in the Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown. He pilots the Skybreaker Troop Transport.
Slagg is an orc cooking trainer located in Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands. He teaches cooks how to make Barbecued Buzzard Wings.

Slave Master Blackheart is a rare Dark Iron dwarf found in the Slag Pit in the Searing Gorge. According to the official World of Warcraft Atlas, he is rated as Uncommon rarity with a respawn timer of ~5-8 hours.
Slain Stockade Rifleman is a deceased human located in Stormwind Stockade.
Slain Alliance Footman is a deceased human located in Nazmir.
Slain Blacktalon Lookout is an orc located in Deadwind Pass.
Slaughtered Cannoneer is a human located in Stormsong Valley.
Slaughtered Shipwright is a human located in Stormsong Valley.
Skytouch is a Windwalker monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Skyreach (monk talent).
Sleepy Joe is a human found sleeping atop a tower in the Merchant Coast in the Northern Barrens.
Sloan Simmersquall is a Wildhammer dwarf food and drink vendor in Thundermar in the Twilight Highlands.
Slitesh is a blood elf located at the Fel Hammer in Mardum. She only appears in the Fel Hammer if you have researched the order advancement trait Fel Armaments.
Slithering Serpents is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Bond of the Unseen Path and Thunderslash traits.
Slim's Friend was a human located in Menethil Harbor in Wetlands. He spawns during The Missing Diplomat (11) to help his friend Tapoke "Slim" Jahn when he comes under attack.
Sloooow Down is an Arcane mage artifact trait. It is linked to the Ethereal Sensitivity and Torrential Barrage traits.
Sli'thrus is a naga lord located in the Dreadpearl Cavern in Zuldazar.
Slepigos was a blue dragon who was slain by his kin. His name is on a Crumbling Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Sly Garrett is a human poison vendor located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

Smith Slagtree is an orc blacksmithing vendor located in Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands. He can be found working near the forge and anvil in the village. He sells all the standard blacksmithing supplies such as Strong Flux and can also provide repairs to adventurer's gear. He is currently (and most likely will remain) the only person who can repair in Revantusk Village.
Smith Argus is a human artisan blacksmithing trainer located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
Small Silk Pack is a 10 slot general-purpose bag. Other silk bags include Green Silk Pack and Black Silk Pack.

James Hyal (aka Smiling Jim) is a human who ran the Shady Rest Inn before it was burned to the ground by Grimtotem tauren. His wife and child were killed in the fire and James is reportedly "not the same" since the incident. He currently sits next to the inn on Theramore Isle. He has a brother, Vincent Hyal, in Menethil Harbor who is unaware of the tragedy of the Shady Rest Inn and sends the player to check on James. With the coming of patch 2.3, the story of Shady Rest Inn finally got an ending. It's unknown if he survived the Attack on Theramore Isle, though a Theramore Citizen in the Siege of Orgrimmar uses his exact appearance.
Smith Regzar is an orc found in Alterac Valley. He appears during the Heritage of Draenor questline at Frostwolf Village.
Smacky is a human child located on the outer ring at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran during Here Comes the BOOM!. He has stolen a Barrel of Green Fireworks from Didi the Wrench.
Snang is an orc located in Magar's Cloth Goods in the Drag in Orgrimmar. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Tor'phan. He appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar being overtaken by the Void.

Smudge Thunderwood is a dwarf poison vendor located in the Ravenholdt Manor basement of Hillsbrad Foothills. His brother is Dirk Thunderwood, who ran the poison operations in Cenarion Hold. He is also found in the Hall of Shadows selling Recipe: Thistle Tea.
Snokh Blackspine is a quilboar fire mage, and is part of Theldren's team of gladiators at the Blackrock Depths arena.
Snixx Quickfreeze is a goblin ice cream vendor and member of the Cone of Cold who sets up shop at the Orgrimmar Embassy in Orgrimmar during Children's Week, alongside his Ice Elementals.

Sneevel is a pale orc located at Anguish Fortress in . He and his brethren snuck into the fortress and killed the locals living in the valley. They now feast on the corpses of those that remained and fought.
Snipehunter Goro is a Mag'har orc located at the Brewfest Grounds in Durotar.
Snake Bite is a row 8 Beast Mastery hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Master Handler.
Sognar Cliffbeard is a wandering dwarf meat vendor located in the Military Ward in Ironforge.
Sodalite Band is a world drop from most demon and humanoid monsters in zones.

Soff is a human captain of Alterac, serving his uncle captain Aretain Naris and is noted to be one of his best captains. However, he gets jealous of the affection that his uncle shows toward their old comrades. He tries to get them drunk (usually he is rather inebriated himself) and draw them into a fight.
Sogra Stonegrip is an orc guild banker found in Warspear Hold in Warspear on Ashran.
Snoozie is a young faerie dragon found sleeping in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.
Soleil Stonemantle is a dwarf banker located in the Vault of Ironforge in Ironforge.

Solm Hargrin is a dwarf rogue trainer located in Anvilmar in Dun Morogh. He is a firm believer in honor amongst thieves, as his instructions to new rogue arrivals reveal. He believes that with the strained international relations of the time, rogues will play a bigger role in the near future. He gladly welcomes the company of other rogues; dwarf and gnome alike.
Solomon is a human located at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.
Sol-Shaper Krivin is an arakkoa found at "shrine to the raven god" in the Lost Veil Anzu of Spires of Arak. Krivin uses the gift of Rukhmar to transform into Aspect of Rukhmar.

Solog Roark is a Blackrock orc being held as a prisoner aboard a train at the Iron Docks in Gorgrond. An engineering prodigy, Solog was responsible for designing and building the Iron Docks and the dreadnaughts that sail the Draenic seas. He's considered a genius around a drydock. After took control over the Iron Horde, Solog refused to drink the Blood of Mannoroth and was imprisoned alongside other Blackrock orcs that refused. Command of the Iron Docks was then given to Admiral Knar. Solog wants Knar killed, and when the commander does so, Solog goes mercenary and joins the commander's army and aids in the construction of the Garrison Shipyard.
Song was a student of Kang, the first pandaren monk, who became the founder of the Lorewalkers after the pandaren revolution.
Solemn Prayers is a Discipline priest honor talent, available at rank 40.
Sonya Shadowdancer is a human found underground. She is a rogue with an unknown backstory.
Solomon Lee is a former member of Blizzard Entertainment. He was on the original World of Warcraft design team. He later joined Riot Games to work on League of Legends.
Solarys Thorngale is a night elf located at Amirdrassil in the Emerald Dream. She is kneeling in front of Amirdrassil Defenders, pleading to listen to her.

Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan was the leader of the shadowy sorcerers of the Dark Iron clan before and during the War of the Three Hammers. He was the one responsible for first summoning the Firelord Ragnaros into Azeroth.

Sorcerer Ashcrombe is an elite human imprisoned in the haunted Shadowfang Keep. Deathstalker Adamant was in a nearby cell. After Rethilgore had been defeated, Alliance players could ask Ashcrombe to open the gate to the rest of the instance. On the other hand, Horde players could choose to kill Ashcrombe. Horde players saw Ashcrombe as a level 20 non-elite and not flagged for PvP. Ashcrombe no longer appears in the post-Cataclysm Shadowfang Keep, and his fate remains unclear.
Soryn is a blood elf armor vendor in the Sun's Reach Armory of the Isle of Quel'Danas. He sells Season 2 armor in exchange for Tier 6 loot tokens.
Sorrow is a Forsaken priest who wanders around Dalaran and acts like a player (using Hearthstone, training professions, checking the bank, etc.).
Sophie Aaren is a human florist located in the Aaren's Flowers flower shop on Festival Lane in Old Stratholme.
Soratha is a jungle troll mage trainer located in the Darkspear Training Grounds of the Darkspear Isle on the Echo Isles in Durotar. When Zalazane returned, he defended the area.
Soul Dance is a level 100 monk talent, available only to Brewmaster monks, added in Warlords of Draenor.
Soothing Tendrils is a level 100 monk talent, added in Warlords of Draenor. It is granted to Mistweaver monks choosing Serene Mists.
Sorah Cinderglow is a blood elf located at the Sunsworn Camp in Talador.
Soul-Twister Torek is an orc located at the Pillars of Fate in Spires of Arak.
Sorallus is a fel lord located in the Halls of the Eclipse of Suramar.
Soothing Remedies is a Mistweaver monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Mists of Wisdom and Shroud of Mist traits.

Sophia is a human girl disguise that the Horde adventurer puts on during Corner Crossing and Tracking Tipoff using the Humanizing Potion. Dark Ranger Lyana disguised herself as Marion Sutton and claimed that Sophia is her daughter. It is unknown if Sophia is a real human, and what her connection to the real Marion Sutton is.
Soul Furnace is a conduit for vengeance demon hunters. It drops from the Sun King's Salvation in Castle Nathria, Oryphrion in the Spires of Ascension, and Dausegne in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Soul Asylum was a level 57 Frost death knight talent. It was only present for a short time at the beginning of the alpha before it was replaced with Gathering Storm.
Sorotis is a dracthyr located in Valdrakken where she serves as the Titan Artifact turn-in. She is later found at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus as the vendor for Ulderoth items during Time Rifts.
Soragosa is a blue dragon located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
Soulbinder Tuulani is an Auchenai soul priest first encountered in Talador. She becomes a follower after the chapter of the Talador storyline is complete.

Soulbrewer Nadagast is a Forsaken warlock captain of the Horde, who served in Ashran and would later appear at Raven's Glory, the Black Rook Hold arena. In Ashran, Nadagast or another random Horde Captain will spawn each time the Horde reinforcements total reaches 200 or 100.
Soulbiter is a Frost death knight artifact trait. It is only available after acquiring all other artifact traits.

Sovok was an orc who fought in the valleys of Alterac. When his brothers in arms had gained the upper hand in the battle for the valley, he came to Winterspring to tell Reynah Firecaster that her brother had been killed.
Spanky is a human vendor located at the Valley of Heroes in Elwynn Forest. He is an orphan supervised by Orphan Matron Seacole.
Southwatch Game Warden is a deceased human located in Tiragarde Sound. He is found by Lord Kennings and the Alliance adventurer.

Spearmaster Crasc is an orc watching the invasion of Stonefang Outpost in Frostfire Ridge from the watch tower just to the southwest of town. Access the top by jumping from the rock outcrop just east of the tower, as the path is blocked by spears.
Spectral Deflection is a level 57 Blood death knight talent.
Special Delivery is a Brewmaster monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Rushing Jade Wind.
Specialist Wembley is a human located at Fort Daelin in Stormsong Valley.
Spectral Grog is a drink that transforms you into a human pirate ghost for one hour.
Speedy is a dragon turtle companion of Sooli the Survivalist as well as helping out during the healer trials.

Spelunker Lockeye is a void elf found hanging on a chain in the Wild Coast in the Waking Shores. After being rescued, she is located at Wingrest Embassy with Professor Cogcatcher and Archivist Rellid.

Spirit Bond is a tier 5 talent in the Beast Mastery hunter tree. Maxing it requires a total of 22 points in Beast Mastery. This talent causes the hunter and their pet to heal for a small percentage of their max health every ten seconds, so long as the pet is active.
Spiketooth is an orc who worked for Rehgar Earthfury and traveled with his caravan.
Spinning Fire Blossom is a Windwalker monk honor talent, available at rank 46.
Spirit Sage Zran is a human Bone Wastes PvP rewards vendor located at Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest.
Spirit Talker Snarlfang is an orc located at Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra.
Spirit Shell is a Discipline priest talent, available at level 50.
Spiritual Cleansing was a Discipline priest honor talent, available at rank 19.

Spirit Tether is a Mistweaver monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Essence of the Mists, Way of the Mistweaver and Mists of Life (artifact trait) traits. It has a radius of 9 yards from the location of the Transcendence Spirit.
Spiritsinger Umbra is the leader of the tortollans of Un'Goro Crater in the Journey to Un'Goro expansion for Hearthstone.
Spiritspeaker Azun is a troll priest featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Spiritspeaker Azun is a troll who can speak to the dead.
Spiteful Serenity is an Arms warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Anger Management.
Spitting Cobras is a Beast Mastery hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Beast Master (hunter artifact trait), Natural Reflexes, and Spirit Bond (artifact trait) traits.
Splintering Ray is a Frost mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Cryopathy.
Sranda is an orc light armor and weapon vendor located in New Kargath in the Badlands. Before the Cataclysm, she was in Kargath.
Squire Maltrake was the squire of the black dragon Velarok. He could be found southeast of Thorium Point in the Searing Gorge. He has been missing since the Cataclysm.

Sprocket Gyrospring is a gnome warrior featured in DC Unlimited's World of Warcraft: Series 2 action figure set. Sprocket appears to be wearing the Battlegear of Wrath and wielding the Ashbringer. He rides a mechanostrider.
Squeeg Idolhunter is a dwarf located in the Whisper Gulch in the Howling Fjord.

Squire David is a human boy found in the Aspirant's Ring of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. During Death Rising, he and the other children were gathered near the stadium's entrance and protected by an Argent Peacekeeper.
Squallshaper Lanara is an elite human aboard one of the warships docked at Theramore Isle during the Theramore's Fall scenario.
Squire's Vest is the starting chest for human, dwarf, and draenei paladins.
Squiggy is a faerie dragon located at Arbor Glen in . Later on, he can found in Lunarfall.
Squadron Commander Vishax is a fel lord located on an unnamed Legion ship parked near Terminus in Antoran Wastes.
Squad Leader Bosh is an orc located in the Assault on Zan'vess.
Squallshaper Bryson is a human located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Stabby Jane is a human located at Castaway Point in Tiragarde Sound.
Stablemaster Diana is a human located in Southport Watch in Tiragarde Sound. She is one of Fernn's mutineers.
Squire Augustus III is a human located in Brennadam in Stormsong Valley.
Ssavra is an arakkoa member of the Hidden. Ssarbik is her brother.

Stagecoach Carriage is a vehicle boarded by the character for a ride from Greymane Manor ostensibly to Stormglen Village. The carriage is damaged by Ogre Ambushers who hurled boulders at it, causing it to crash. Liam Greymane is found at the site.
Stalker Ogka is a Frostwolf orc found in Wor'var in . She argues with Shadow Hunter Taz.
Staellis Rivermoor is a night elf located in Black Rook Hold. He is released after the defeat of the Amalgam of Souls. He is apparently where the Amalgam gets its scythe.
Staggering Around is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Swift as a Coursing River, Smashed and Fortification traits.
Staff Sergeant Cotner is a human innkeeper located at Fort Daelin in Stormsong Valley.
Stananormu is a bronze dragon located at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
Stanwad is a dwarf located in Explorers' League Outpost in the Howling Fjord.

Stasia Fallshadow is a Forsaken mage who had a special talent for translating ancient tomes. Around the time of Onyxia's death, she arrived to the Pools of Vision, where she used a scroll that she had received from an orc shaman a few months before in Outland. It was a prophecy about the savior of Azeroth. Stasia saw visions of the assassination of Llane Wrynn by the hand of Garona. Garona birthed a child that she gave to Meryl Winterstorm. She immediately set out for Duskwood where she attacked Meryl and Med'an but instead captured and brought Garona Halforcen to Cho'gall in Ahn'Qiraj. Stave Off is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is linked to the Draught of Darkness and Quick Sip (artifact trait) traits.
Steel Gate Chief Archaeologist is a dwarf of the Explorers' League located in Steel Gate in Howling Fjord.
Stephanie Sindree is a human found in King's Square in Old Stratholme. She runs a small stand selling fruit and fish.
Steelbreaker is an iron giant and fearsome general that leads the army of iron giants in Yogg-Saron's name. He is part of the Assembly of Iron encounter in Ulduar.
Stephen Barone is a Forsaken general goods vendor located at New Agamand in Howling Fjord.
Stefen Cotter is a human bartender found in A Hero's Welcome in Dalaran. He sells drinks to Alliance players.
Steeg Haskell is a dwarf guild vendor found at the Ironforge Visitor's Center in Ironforge.
Steelspark LX-506 is a robot built by Kelsey Steelspark, located at Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
Steeljaw's Corpse was an orc located at the Steeljaw's Caravan in the Borean Tundra. He was the leader of the expedition who died on a Taunka burial. The Warsong Banner in located next to him.
Steelbender Jin is a pandaren general goods vendor located at Westwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.
Stephen Hicklin is a human found in the Hero's Rest Inn in Stormshield.
Stephen Chow is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.
Stephen Bitterwind is a human located at Gol Koval in Drustvar.
Stephen Marisport is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.
Sir Stephanos Valik is a character mentioned on the Cracked Sinstone found in Revendreth.
Stelagos was a blue dragon who was slain by nightfallen. His name is on a Faded Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.

Steven Black is a human stable master located in Darkshire in Duskwood. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Steven was killed by the fanatical Night Watchers who joined the Veiled Hand cult.
Steven Allen is a human found along the coast in the northern part of Stormwind Harbor.
Steven Walker is a human vendor found at Nesingwary's Safari in the Valley of the Four Winds. He used to hunt with Ohlorn Farstrider.
Steven Ramalot is a dwarf food and drink vendor located in Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh.
Stinkbraid is a human Southsea pirate. He is the author of the Savory Deviate Delight recipe.
Stigander Ironsnare is a dwarf hunter located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Steven Cochrane is a human tailoring vendor found in Stormshield.
Steve McClory is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.
Steve Martinez is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus.

Stone Guard Zarg is an orc PvP weapon rewards vendor located in the Hall of Legends in Orgrimmar. He sells level 60 High Warlord weapons. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with First Sergeant Hola'mahi and Brave Stonehide.

Stone Guard Mukar is an orc found in Wintergrasp. He appears when the Horde have control over Wintergrasp Fortress. He is directly east of the main doors in the central courtyard. Prior the Battle for the Broken Shore, he is at the Dranosh'ar Blockade and sends adventurers to their boat for the assault.
Stone Gryphon is a common dwarf archaeology artifact that requires 35 fragments, and permits use of one keystone.
Stone Guard Ruk'Ra is an orc located in Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.
Stone Guard Brokefist is an orc located in Warspear. He sells Warlords Season 1 equipment. He was previously a lieutenant.
Stone-Lord Qinsho is a terracotta warrior located on the expedition isles.
Stone-Guard Ognarr is an orc located in the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken.
Stonehoof was a member of the Twilight's Hammer cult working with Stasia Fallshadow. He was killed by Garona in Ahn'Qiraj when she attempted to escape.
Stonebound Colossus is a terracotta warrior‎ located in the Seat of the Spirit Waker in the Jade Forest.

Stonewatch Tower is the secondary structure of the human stronghold of Stonewatch, which also includes the Stonewatch Keep. They both used to be controlled by the humans of Lakeshire but were taken by orcs of the Blackrock clan. Although the scout tower was for quite some time firmly in the hands of Gath'Ilzogg's underlings, after Darkblaze was defeated, the orcish forces left the stronghold deserted.
Stormcaller Brundir is an iron dwarf and fearsome general that leads the army of iron dwarves in Yogg-Saron's name. He is part of the Assembly of Iron encounter in Ulduar.
Stormcaller Mylra is a Wildhammer dwarf located in the Commons in Ironforge. She is a member of the Earthen Ring and is accompanied by her gryphon, Stormbeak.
Storm is a Pandaren spirit warrior created by the Brewmaster.
Storm's Wake Wavespeaker is a human located on a Kul Tiran Rowboat in Talanji's Rebuke in Zuldazar.

Storm Hunter William is a human located at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind. He can also be found with Storm Huntress Suhrakka in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken. He will trade various goods in return for Primeval Essence.
Storidormi is a bronze dragon located at the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken. She is telling stories to a group of Attentive Whelps and their Whelp Minder.
